articles.title: Crypto companies have spent $189M so far on 2026 US election cycle: Report
articles.snippet: The crypto industry, Big Tech and gambling interest groups are betting big on politicians in the 2026 primaries and elections, with almost $300 million shelled out so far.

articles.title: UN's First AI Safety Panel Says Scientists Can't Rule Out 'Catastrophic Harm'
articles.snippet: A 40-scientist panel found that AI capabilities are outrunning both scientific understanding and government oversight.

articles.title: Trump-Backed American Bitcoin Hits New Low Price Ahead of Reverse Stock Split
articles.snippet: Bitcoin mining firm American Bitcoin fell to a new low price Wednesday, one day before executing a 1-for-15 reverse stock split.

articles.title: China Has Its Own Mythos Now, Says Qihoo 360 Founder. And One Version Is Free
articles.snippet: Qihoo 360 unveiled a homegrown vulnerability-hunting AI this week—and Z.ai went further, releasing comparable capabilities as open-weight code anyone can download.
